characters.description: One of Tameland's historical marked heroes. The saint requires time to complete a seasonal miracle that destroys a horde of muck warpers, and favors overwhelming force despite the delay and exhaustion involved.
characters.name: Historical saint

characters.description: A gifted Generasi student preparing for a research expedition to Tameland. Alex combines alchemy, combat magic, and careful planning, directs Claygon through a mental link, and privately carries the dangerous burden of being the Fool.
characters.name: Alex Roth

characters.description: Alex's partner and a highly skilled hunter whose archery is central to the group's plan against a dune worm. She works smoothly with Alex and Claygon and is willing to test specialized alchemical arrows in live combat.
characters.name: Theresa Lu

characters.description: Alex's younger sister, a talented young sculptor, and one of Claygon's creators. She is recovering from trauma connected to fire while continuing to shape clay figures and take an active interest in magic.
characters.name: Selina

characters.description: A four-armed clay golem created by Alex and Selina. Claygon is Alex's exceptionally strong bodyguard, follows commands through their mental connection, and gives the student combat group a durable front-line fighter.
characters.name: Claygon

characters.description: Generasi's chancellor, Alex's combat instructor, and the organizer of a proposed research mission to Tameland. He directs the students' final practical while pursuing historical questions surrounding Alex's unusual magic.
characters.name: Baelin

characters.description: A prince of Tekizash and one of Alex's student allies. Khalik belongs to Alex's combat cabal and works alongside his eagle familiar, Najyah, as the group plans its final practical.
characters.name: Khalik

characters.description: Khalik's eagle familiar and aerial partner. Najyah serves as a mobile scout and combatant within Alex's circle, giving Khalik a capable presence in the air during the group's training and expedition preparations.
characters.name: Najyah

characters.description: A Rhinian noble student and member of Alex's combat cabal. Isolde is Alex's academic rival and works on the flight spell Claygon will need for the group's final practical.
characters.name: Isolde

characters.description: A powerful minotaur student in Alex's combat cabal. Thundar brings considerable physical strength to the group as it prepares for its final practical against a dune worm.
characters.name: Thundar

characters.description: A formidable sharkman student and Nua-Oge's adopted younger brother. Grimlock trains with Alex's friends and belongs to their wider combat group.
characters.name: Grimlock

characters.description: Grimlock's adopted older sister and a friend of Alex's household.
characters.name: Nua-Oge

characters.description: A dryad who has become openly affectionate with Khalik. Sinope joins the group's social circle during the Games, though the exact nature and future of their developing relationship are not yet defined.
characters.name: Sinope

characters.description: Theresa's trusted Cerberus, hunting companion, and household protector. Once a source of concern for Alex, Brutus is now a reliable member of the family circle.
characters.name: Brutus

characters.description: Theresa's father, arriving in Generasi for a month-long family visit. He reunites warmly with Theresa, Alex, and Selina before a magical disturbance interrupts their arrival.
characters.name: Mr. Lu

characters.description: Theresa's mother, arriving in Generasi for a month-long family visit. She reunites warmly with Theresa, Alex, and Selina before a magical disturbance interrupts their arrival.
characters.name: Mrs. Lu

characters.description: Theresa's father, identified when the visiting family registers for university lodging after the disturbance at City Hall.
characters.name: Yutong Liu

characters.description: Theresa's mother, identified when the visiting family registers for university lodging after the disturbance at City Hall.
characters.name: Tse Moi Liu

characters.description: Alex's alchemy professor, who advises him when Claygon appears to react unexpectedly. The professor explains why ordinary golem behavior offers little certainty about Claygon's unusual core.
characters.name: Alchemy professor

characters.description: Alex's summoning instructor for the condensed summer course. The instructor teaches a respectful, contract-based approach in which summoned beings may negotiate terms or refuse an alliance.
characters.name: Summoning instructor

characters.description: The instructor for Alex and Khalik's Magical Botany course, where dangerous plants demand careful identification and handling.
characters.name: Magical Botany instructor

characters.description: The Magical Botany professor who receives Keebus's warning that the demon summoner is concealed in the botanical gardens and immediately calls for Baelin.
characters.name: Professor Salinger

characters.description: A professor involved in reorganizing the delayed Tameland expedition after the Games attack. Professor Jules also discusses the sentences imposed on the conspirators.
characters.name: Professor Jules

characters.description: Alex's summoning professor, who emphasizes the risks of provoking demons and of relying on poorly controlled summoning contracts.
characters.name: Professor Mangle

characters.description: A goblin student accompanied by Harmless, his crocodile familiar. Keebus reconnects with Alex's group when they meet before the Games.
characters.name: Keebus

characters.description: Keebus's crocodile familiar, already about four feet long when the pair reconnect with Alex's group before the Games.
characters.name: Harmless

characters.description: Isolde's former partner and a member of a student society marked by a two-headed-beast emblem. He previously cheated by using Isolde's work, and his presence still unsettles her.
characters.name: Derek Warren

characters.description: One of Amir's graduate associates connected to the planned expedition. Leopold discusses Generasi's history and the dangers of divine power, but Alex has no proof that he or the others are involved in the recent attacks.
characters.name: Leopold Richter

characters.description: Alex's former laboratory supervisor and a graduate associate assigned to the expedition. Amir appears nervous while the research group is under scrutiny, giving Alex reason for caution but not enough evidence for an accusation.
characters.name: Amir Abu Saleh

characters.description: A scarred, three-eyed demon that singles Alex out during the attack and reacts to his unusual teleportation magic. Alex gives it a temporary name while trying to disrupt its sharp senses and survive its assault.
characters.name: Burnsaw

characters.description: A powerful crystalline demon compelled by a life debt to support the attack on the centaur priests and stadium defenders. The knight enters the conflict as a contracted servant rather than a willing subordinate.
characters.name: Abyssal knight

characters.description: A lava mage competing in Claygon's Duel of Proxies division. Tyrus meets Alex as a confident prospective rival and has entered several Games events, making her a likely obstacle beyond their first tournament.
characters.name: Tyrus Goldtooth

characters.description: An enormous tournament entrant accompanying Tyrus Goldtooth. Its shell contains a functioning volcano, and Tyrus treats the creature with familiarity and care.
characters.name: Tyrus Goldtooth's volcano tortoise

characters.description: Tyrus Goldtooth's enormous volcano tortoise and tournament companion. Vesuvius carries a working volcano on his shell and presents Claygon with a rival of extraordinary size and destructive potential.
characters.name: Vesuvius

characters.description: The obstacle-marathon winner and an opposing Grand Battle competitor. His life-force enhancement grants exceptional speed, senses, strength, and stamina.
characters.name: Indrajit Hanuman

characters.description: Taraka Shale's son and a competitor in the super-heavyweight Duel of Proxies, where he is accompanied by a stone golem.
characters.name: Sim Shale

characters.description: Sim Shale's stone golem and Claygon's tournament opponent. Shaleleaf attacks with force magic and detachable flying forearms while using five duplicates to conceal the real golem.
characters.name: Shaleleaf

characters.description: A medical blood mage assigned to accompany Alex's survey team. Hiragi Makaira joins the mission as its dedicated field healer when the expedition is ready to enter Tameland and begin the first Greymoor survey.
characters.name: Hiragi Makaira

characters.description: Tameland's king, who receives Generasi's delegation and questions how it obtained dungeon-core remains. He negotiates the terms that authorize Generasi's research territory and expedition.
characters.name: King Athelstan Mercio

characters.description: The hostile presence that Tameland's high priest identifies within the kingdom's pervasive magic. Its signature resembles the force associated with Claygon, making it central to the proposed dungeon-core investigation.
characters.name: The Ravener

characters.description: An unresolved historical figure linked to an old foreign book, an unknown language, and the strange force affecting Alex's transportation magic. Baelin continues searching records and distant contacts for a reliable lead.
characters.name: The Traveler

characters.description: A woman whom a demon once sought across other demonic domains. Burnsaw's reaction gives Baelin reason to consider a connection with the Traveler, but the known dates conflict and leave the identification unproven.
characters.name: Hannah Sim
